description: Agent tools of the BuildY page builder: one definition per tool (name, description, JSON Schema parameters) and the chat modes that offer it. Hosts (chat runtime, WordPress builder) send only the tools of the active mode. x-buildy-enum names a value list the host fills from its pinned catalog or page contract before sending; hosts strip every x-* keyword. See ADR-0011.

ask.description: Conversation about the catalog and the page. Ask never changes the page: a write_page proposal is kept as a card the author applies in Build. Tool choice auto; the model's final text is the answer.

build.description: Edit the page. Tool choice auto: a text-only answer is shown and creates no proposal; a successful write_page creates one pending proposal (a diff) the author applies with Apply.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search Stock screens by q (catalog terms) and facets (site, section, job, industry, blocks). Screens are ranking hints: each result lists its sections as registry items [{item, variant}] you may start from or ignore. When no renderable screen matches every facet the host drops the fewest facets and says which in relaxed. Do not repeat a search that returned items.

descriptionByMode.ask: Search Stock screens by q (catalog terms) and facets (site, section, job, industry, blocks). Returns scored screens with their sections as registry items. Read-only.

q.description: Free text in catalog terms (English catalog words work best, e.g. sidebar, shell, kanban, pricing). Matched against Stock titles, subtitles, block names and facet labels.

site.description: Site type: landing (one conversion page), website (multi-page site home), app, docs, shop, blog.

blocks.description: Block labels every screen must contain, e.g. ["sidenav"] for a built-in sidebar.

browse.description: true: also return facets (renderable screen counts per facet value for this filter) to drill down with another call.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Read one registry item: its variants (what each sets), the props you write (names, kinds, enums, rows; ? = optional), the sample props a new block starts with, and its Stock link. item is a registry name from the item index (feature-grid), a Stock spec (block.features) or label. Read-only.

item.description: Registry item name, Stock spec or label.

variant.description: Variant whose sample props to show; default variant when omitted.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read the page document as it is now in this turn: { version, slug, title, locale, seo, blocks:[{ id, item, variant, props }] }. props are exactly the component props. Read-only.

tools.name: write_page

descriptionByMode.ask: Write a proposal for the page: send the whole page document ({ page }) or an RFC 6902 JSON Patch of it ({ patch }). Nothing is applied: the author applies the proposal in Build with one click. On a problem the host returns [{ path, code, expected, got }] and changes nothing; fix those paths and write again.
descriptionByMode.build: Write the page: send the whole page document ({ page }) or an RFC 6902 JSON Patch of it ({ patch }). The host checks it (page-spec/v2 schema, each block's props against the registry props schema, header-like items first, footer-like last) and returns the diff; the author applies it with Apply. On a problem the host returns [{ path, code, expected, got }] and changes nothing; fix those paths and write again.

tools.description: Write the page: send the whole page document ({ page }) or an RFC 6902 JSON Patch of it ({ patch }). The host checks it and returns the diff or [{ path, code, expected, got }].

page.description: The whole page document: { title, slug, locale, seo: { title, description }, blocks: [{ id?, item, variant?, props }] }. A block without id gets one; a new block starts from the registry sample props, then your props. locale is the ISO code of the language the author writes in.

patch.description: RFC 6902 operations on the page document (add, replace, remove, move, copy, test), paths as JSON Pointers: /title, /locale, /seo/description, /blocks/2/props/title, /blocks/- (append).
